sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT V OF 1997
ACT V OF 1997
TERRITORIAL WATERS AND MARITIME ZONES
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1997
An Act further to amend the Territorial Waters
and Maritime Zones Act, 1976
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
16th April, 1997]
F.No.22 (86)/97‑Legis., dated 16‑4‑1997.‑‑The
following Act of Majlis‑e‑Shoora (Parliament) received the assent
of the President on the 14th April, 1997, and is hereby published for general
information:--
Whereas it is expedient further to amend the
Territorial Waters and Maritime Zones Act, 1976 (LXXXII of 1976), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:‑‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(1) This Act may be
called the Territorial Waters and Maritime Zones (Amendment) Act, 1997.

sections.shortTitle: Territorial Waters and Maritime Zones Amendment Act 1997
sections.description:
Amendment of section 5, Act LXXXII of 1976

ACT V OF 1997
ACT V OF 1997
TERRITORIAL WATERS AND MARITIME ZONES
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1997
An Act further to amend the Territorial Waters
and Maritime Zones Act, 1976
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
16th April, 1997]
F.No.22 (86)/97‑Legis., dated 16‑4‑1997.‑‑The
following Act of Majlis‑e‑Shoora (Parliament) received the assent
of the President on the 14th April, 1997, and is hereby published for general
information:--
Whereas it is expedient further to amend the
Territorial Waters and Maritime Zones Act, 1976 (LXXXII of 1976), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 5, Act LXXXII of 1976.‑‑In the Territorial
Waters and Maritime Zones Act, 1976 (LXXXII of 1976), in section 5,‑‑
(a) in subsection (2),‑‑
(i) for clause (a) the following shall be
substituted, namely:‑‑
"(a) exclusive sovereign rights for the
purpose of exploring and exploiting minerals and other non‑living
resources of the bed and sub‑soil together with living organisms
belonging to the sedentary species;"; and
(ii) after clause (d), the following
explanation shall be added, namely:‑‑
"Explanation.‑‑For the purpose
of this subsection, the expression 'living organisms' shall mean those
organisms which, at the harvestable stage, are either immobile under the sea‑bed
or are enable to move except in constant physical contact with the sea‑bed
or the sub‑soil. "; and
(b) in subsection (4), in clause (a), the words
"and its superjacent water" shall be omitted.
